relation_decisions.target_truth: Keep align vs coordinate as a sense-specific partial-overlap boundary: align emphasizes bringing into line/agreement or fitting with a reference; coordinate emphasizes organizing parts/people/actions so they work together.

The allow vs let boundary is learner-worthy, but construction difference is essential: allow sb to do sth vs let sb do sth. Current Relation metadata says 'sb to do' generically and overreduces the distinction to formal-vs-colloquial. Rebuild around permission + syntax + register.

Keep allow/permit/enable boundary: allow and permit can grant permission or make something possible, permit is generally more formal, while enable primarily makes someone/something able or makes an outcome possible rather than granting permission.

decisions.target_truth: Keep agreement/consent, compatibility, and familiar-new 'food/climate does not agree with sb' branches. Consolidate learner-worthy structures agree with sb/sth, agree on sth, agree to sth, agree to do sth, and agreed that...; Current duplicates the same structures across sense collocations and multiple construction objects.

Keep pleasant/enjoyable as the ordinary adjective. Distinguish formal agreeable to sth as acceptable/suitable or willing to accept/agree, rather than treating every 'agreeable to' use as generic agreement. Preserve register and complement boundary.

Keep agriculture=farming/cultivation and the science/practice of farming as one coherent noun center. Do not treat unnatural 'agriculture industry' as a model collocation; adjective-owned 'agricultural industry/sector' belongs to agricultural/word-family knowledge.

Keep spatial, temporal and progress/lead meanings under one ahead center. Make high-value ahead of and go ahead structures explicit. Avoid duplicating the same lead/progress meaning merely because one row is labeled adjective and another adverb.

Keep noun aim=purpose, verb aim at a physical target, and verb aim=intend/try to achieve. Add high-value aim to do sth. Consolidate duplicate aim-at construction objects and preserve distinctions among aim at doing, aim for sth, and physical aim at sb/sth.

Keep ordinary air, sky/airspace where useful, atmosphere/manner, ventilate/dry, and modern verb air=express/broadcast opinions or grievances. Demote ancient-four-elements air to reference/recognition. Treat in the air and air views/grievances as lexicalized phrase/construction knowledge when appropriate rather than burying modern uses behind specialist completeness.

Use ordinary passage between rows of seats/shelves as the main sense. Keep church architectural side-aisle only as lower reference/recognition. Preserve walk down the aisle as a high-value lexicalized marriage phrase rather than treating it as ordinary spatial collocation only.

Distinguish alcohol as alcoholic drink/ethanol in drinks from chemistry alcohol=a class of organic compounds containing a hydroxyl group, with ethanol one member. Current chemical definition incorrectly defines the class as volatile hydroxyl compounds made from hydrocarbons by distillation.

Represent ordinary modern noun alien=extraterrestrial, adjective alien=foreign/strange, and alien to sth=unfamiliar/incompatible. Legal/formal noncitizen use is recognition/reference-level rather than the default noun center. Avoid loaded/outdated 'illegal alien' as the central learner example.

Restore ordinary main verb alienate sb / alienate sb from others=sour relations, make hostile, isolated or estranged. Legal property/rights transfer is a specialist lower-priority sense and must not displace the ordinary meaning while Core says '使疏远'.
Keep alive=living, alive with=full of activity, and alive to=aware/sensitive to. Remove the purported volcano sense and invalid example 'an alive volcano'; English uses active volcano.

Use one broader learner center: loyalty/commitment to a person, group, country, sovereign, cause, or principle. Current Active definition is unnecessarily restricted to citizens/country or subjects/sovereign even though Core correctly includes cause.

Keep alliance as a cooperative union/relationship or formal agreement between countries, organizations or groups. Treaty/agreement is part of the same main alliance concept rather than a separate dictionary-completeness L3 sense; kinship/marriage alliance is valid but lower recognition unless context requires it.

Keep regular money/payment allowance and permitted quota/amount as main branches; retain tax/technical allowance at appropriate depth. Treat make allowance(s) for as a separate high-value phrase meaning take account of, adjust for, or be tolerant of—not as a collocation semantically attached to the pocket-money definition.

Keep plain preposition/adverb along=following a line/forward. Represent along with as a separate together-with construction. Come along, bring along, and tag along are lexicalized phrasal expressions and should not serve as ordinary collocation evidence for generic along senses.
Core is audibly/using the voice rather than silently. Remove default Chinese '大声地', because aloud does not itself mean loudly. Preserve read aloud as the high-value phrase.
